dedupe_keys.name: openstudio server and the openstudio analysis framework osaf

description: OpenStudio Server is a web application and distributed computing tool that forms the backbone of the OpenStudio Analysis Framework, which makes parametric analysis of building energy models accessible to architects, engineers and designers through the OpenStudio Parametric Analysis Tool or the OpenStudio Analysis gem. Each analysis may include many OpenStudio simulations; the framework is described in 'An open source analysis framework for large-scale building energy modeling' by Ball, Long, Fleming, Balbach, Lopez and others (Journal of Building Performance Simulation, 2020). Deployment is by a Helm chart on AWS, Azure or Google Kubernetes clusters, by Docker Swarm locally, or by an embedded openstudio_meta package that needs MongoDB and Ruby. Coverage: any OpenStudio model. Access: free source on GitHub, with tagged releases up to v3.9.0 release candidates seen. Licence: the OpenStudio BSD-style licence of the Alliance for Sustainable Energy. Caveats: running a cluster requires cloud or HPC administration skills. Simulation uses: large parametric, sensitivity, calibration and optimisation runs, including stock-scale studies. Related records: OpenStudio, EnergyPlus, ResStock and ComStock.
